symbols.name: role endpoint operator
symbols.meaning: The operator $D_{\mathrm{sink}(\rho(\ell))}D_{\mathrm{source}(\ell)}^{-1}$ that the frames at the ends of the route of role $\ell$ give to its array.
symbols.quote: Write $\mathcal{E}_\ell$ for the endpoint operator of role $\ell$, $D_{\mathrm{sink}(\rho(\ell))}\,D_{\mathrm{source}(\ell)}^{-1}$, with $\mathrm{source}(\ell)$ and $\mathrm{sink}(\rho(\ell))$ the vertices where the two roles start and end.

relations.quote: The endpoint operator is realised by a [linear network](linear-network-frames.md) on each role array once all intermediate frames have cancelled, so it depends only on the frames at the two ends of a route.
The endpoint operator is instantiated by the [bit procedure](bit-procedure.md).
The endpoint operator of the bit procedure is implemented by [field interchanges](address-interchange.md).
The endpoint operator maps the stored form of the [logical array](logical-array.md) $g$ at the start of the route to its stored form at the end.
So the endpoint operator holds on every role of the [subset-intersection network](subset-intersection-network.md).
